channel.title: LibMake: Rust Library Scaffold Generator
channel.description: LibMake is a Rust CLI tool that generates a complete library scaffold — Cargo.toml, src/lib.rs with doc templates, test and benchmark harnesses, and GitHub Actions CI — from a single command or a versioned TOML/YAML config file.
